laws.rule: One-off fee for driving onto the Curonian Spit: passenger car €10 (about A$15.89 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) from 21 August to 19 June and €50 (about A$79.45 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) from 20 June to 20 August; motorcycles €10; fully electric vehicles €25 (in the peak column).
laws.heading: Vehicle entry fee

laws.rule: Curonian Spit National Park (Lithuanian side): tents, campers and mobile homes are allowed only in equipped, marked places; vehicles stay on hard-surface roads and park only where signs mark a spot; bonfires are made only in specially equipped, marked places, after first notifying the forest fire watch service (numbers on the Neringa tourism page). In the Nagliai and Grobštas nature reserves, walking and driving are limited to the established foot and cycle paths; walking on the wet part of the beach is allowed. Dune, dog, drone and fine rules were not on the page and are not recorded.
